candidates.title: Persisted Data Does Not Become Durable Memory
candidates.title_zh: 存进数据库，不等于成为长期记忆
candidates.researchQuestion: 持久化智能体必须区分哪些事实，临时上下文才能与长期记忆安全共存；其中哪些区别得到受控证据支持，哪些仍只是架构推论？
candidates.coreProposition: 持久化智能体应把长期记忆表示为带来源、权限与时间边界的显式承诺，分别保存观察内容、生命周期分类、写入路径与读取权限，并把提升和撤销记录为可审计转换。

sections.heading: The Experiment Starts After the Commitment
Four Memory Identities Must Stay Separate
sections.heading_zh: 四种记忆身份必须分开

sections.heading: Promotion and Revocation Need Events
sections.heading_zh: 提升与撤销需要显式事件

sections.heading: Better Retention Is Not Better Truth
sections.heading_zh: 保留得更久不等于更真实

sections.heading: A Governed Memory Contract
sections.heading_zh: 一份受治理的记忆合同

evidenceClaims.claim: LifeFuse-Mem labels writes by lifecycle, separates stable and plastic memory subspaces, uses supervised routing, and applies lifecycle-aware protected readout in the controlled setting.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: LifeFuse-Mem 在受控设置中为写入提供生命周期标签，分离稳定与可塑记忆子空间，使用受监督路由和生命周期感知的受保护读取。

evidenceClaims.claim: On the 1,000-episode benchmark, reported configurations retain more acquired permanent facts and suffer less temporary overwrite than evaluated baselines, while substantial overwrite remains.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，在一千个片段的基准中，该配置比被评估基线保留更多已获得长期事实并减少临时覆盖，但仍存在显著覆盖。

evidenceClaims.claim: Removing route supervision materially reduces permanent-fact retention on both reported backbones.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，移除路由监督会明显降低两种模型骨干上的长期事实保留。

evidenceClaims.claim: The experimental setting supplies lifecycle labels and phase structure and does not demonstrate autonomous classification, a general promotion protocol, or durable-memory revocation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 实验预先提供生命周期标签与阶段结构，并未展示自主分类、通用提升协议或长期记忆撤销。

evidenceClaims.claim: Observed content, lifecycle classification, memory update path, and read authority should remain separate state identities.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，观察内容、生命周期分类、记忆写入路径与读取权限应保持为不同状态身份。

evidenceClaims.claim: Durable classification should be a provenance-bearing commitment, with promotion and revocation represented as explicit transitions.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，长期分类应是带来源的承诺，提升与撤销应表示为显式转换。

evidenceClaims.claim: Production ownership of lifecycle classification, contradiction revalidation, model migration, and long-running operational cost remain open.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 生产环境中的分类责任、矛盾后重新验证、模型迁移与长期运行成本仍待研究。

candidates.title: A Successful Retry Does Not Prove Trustworthy Recovery
candidates.title_zh: 重试成功，不等于恢复可信
candidates.researchQuestion: 智能体工作流在首次失败后恢复时，必须分别保存哪些事实，才能证明恢复有效、正确且安全，而不只是后来一次尝试成功？
candidates.coreProposition: 智能体恢复应被表示为一组分别取证的阶段：失败检测、恢复路由、修正输入、重试预算、结果验收与外部效果核对；更复杂的反思只有在带来可测增益时才值得增加。

sections.heading: Richer Reflection Added Little Here
sections.heading_zh: 更复杂反思在这里增益很小

sections.heading: More Attempts Are Not the Same Mechanism
sections.heading_zh: 更多尝试不是同一种机制

sections.heading: Six Recovery Identities Must Stay Separate
sections.heading_zh: 六种恢复身份必须分开

sections.heading: Effect Reconciliation Comes Before Replay
sections.heading_zh: 重放前必须先核对外部效果

sections.heading: Recovery Policy Follows Failure Class
sections.heading_zh: 恢复策略取决于失败类型

evidenceClaims.claim: LAST-CQ decomposes text-to-Cypher work into deterministic schema parsing, initial generation, execution-grounded validation, correction, and execution, with one bounded correction attempt.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: LAST-CQ 将文本到图数据库查询工作拆为确定性模式解析、首次生成、执行环境验证、修正与执行，并只允许一次有界修正。

evidenceClaims.claim: Across six evaluated backbones, the paper reports a 91.7% unweighted mean recovery rate and a 93.8% pooled recovery rate for failures entering correction.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，六种模型中进入修正路径的失败取得91.7%的未加权平均恢复率与93.8%的汇总恢复率。

evidenceClaims.claim: Replacing synthesized feedback with raw database errors changes aggregate exact match only slightly in this benchmark.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，在该基准中，用原始数据库错误替换合成反馈只小幅改变总体精确匹配。

evidenceClaims.claim: Equal-budget parallel three-sample selection performs worse than the execution-grounded iterative path on the reported models.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告，在相同预算下，并行三样本选择弱于带执行环境反馈的迭代路径。

evidenceClaims.claim: Non-empty execution is not semantic correctness; the model judge is optimistic relative to human calibration, and recovery varies sharply by failure class.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 非空执行不等于语义正确；模型评审相对人工校准偏乐观，恢复表现也随失败类别显著变化。

evidenceClaims.claim: Failure detection, recovery routing, correction input, retry budget, acceptance, and external-effect reconciliation require separate evidence identities.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，失败检测、恢复路由、修正输入、重试预算、验收与外部效果核对需要不同证据身份。

evidenceClaims.claim: Recovery policy should depend on failure observability and effect risk rather than use a universal retry rule.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 本文据此解释，恢复策略应取决于失败可观察性与效果风险，而不是采用统一重试规则。

evidenceClaims.claim: Exactly-once effects, idempotency, compensation, authority continuity, and transfer to general state-changing tools remain unproved.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 恰好一次效果、幂等、补偿、授权连续性及向一般有副作用工具迁移仍未得到证明。
